experienced_via: Widget test suite - 8 automated tests measuring all acceptance criteria with Flutter test framework

criterion_1_selected_color.requirement: Chip selecionado tem cor/background claro (não ambíguo)
criterion_1_selected_color.evidence: Code line 77: backgroundColor = scheme.primary (uses theme primary color #005A80 light, #4DD0E1 dark). Selected state renders with clear primary color feedback.

criterion_2_unselected_distinct.requirement: Chip não selecionado é visualmente distinto (outline ou cor pálida)
criterion_2_unselected_distinct.evidence: Code lines 86-107: Default states have borderWidth=1.0 outline and variant-specific pale backgrounds (0xFFF0EDE6 light input, 0xFFFFAF8F5 light suggestion, etc). Clear visual distinction from selected state.

criterion_3_spacing_consistent.requirement: Espaçamento entre chips é consistente (gap >= 8 dp)
criterion_3_spacing_consistent.evidence: Code line 220: assert(spacing >= 8.0) enforces minimum spacing. Wrap component (lines 224-226) manages spacing. Test confirms assertion prevents spacing < 8dp.

criterion_4_disabled_dead.requirement: Estados disabled ficam visivamente mortos (opacidade, sem interação)
criterion_4_disabled_dead.evidence: Code lines 68-74: Disabled state has withValues(alpha: 0.4). Line 111: additional opacity reduction to 0.6 total. Line 128: onSelected callback set to null when disabled. Test confirms disabled chip does not respond to tap.

criterion_5_text_wrapping.requirement: Texto não trunca — quebra em 2 linhas se necessário
criterion_5_text_wrapping.evidence: Code lines 181-182: maxLines: 2, overflow: TextOverflow.clip (no ellipsis). Test confirms long text wraps without truncation ellipsis.

criterion_6_height_36dp.evidence: Widget test measurement: actual height = 30.0 dp. Spec requires >= 36.0 dp. Code comment (lines 58-59) claims '36 dp = 4 dp * 2 + 28 dp text' but actual rendering is 30 dp. This is 6 dp below spec minimum.

criterion_7_icon_spacing.requirement: Ícones têm espaçamento de 8 dp do texto
criterion_7_icon_spacing.evidence: Code line 186: const spacing = SizedBox(width: 8.0) explicitly placed between icon and text (lines 195, 200). Test confirms icon renders with correct spacing.

criterion_8_dark_mode.requirement: Dark mode: cores ainda legíveis e distintas
criterion_8_dark_mode.evidence: Code lines 55-56: Uses scheme.brightness to detect mode. Lines 71-86: Different backgrounds for dark (0xFF34322B, 0xFF2C2A24 etc). Uses theme scheme colors which auto-adapt. Dark mode test confirms correct rendering.

vs_material_design_3_chip.height_target: Material 3 spec: 32-48 dp for comfortable touch targets. Sincro AppChip: 30 dp (below minimum).
vs_material_design_3_chip.selection_clarity: EQUAL - Primary color feedback is clear
vs_material_design_3_chip.state_distinction: EQUAL - Default/selected/disabled states are visually distinct
vs_material_design_3_chip.text_handling: EQUAL - Line wrapping instead of truncation

positive_observations: Component has 3 distinct variants (input, suggestion, filter) with different visual treatments
3 explicit states (default, selected, disabled) properly handled
Assertion guard prevents improper spacing in groups (spacing >= 8dp)
Custom padding optimization attempt (though unsuccessful in meeting 36dp target)
Dark mode support with brightness-aware styling
Text wrapping logic prevents truncation (maxLines: 2, TextOverflow.clip)
design_thoughtfulness.implementation_quality: Code is clean, well-commented, uses Material FilterChip as base (solid pattern). However, the height calculation appears to have been theoretical rather than tested.

required_for_wow: CRITICAL FIX: Increase chip height from 30dp to 36dp minimum. Options:
1. Increase vertical padding from 4dp to at least 8dp (would give ~36dp total: 8*2 + ~20dp text)
3. Adjust text size or line height to increase overall chip height
Verify the fix with widget test measuring height >= 36dp before re-submission
pass_fail_summary: REJECTED - Component fails 1 of 8 acceptance criteria. Height is 30dp, spec requires >= 36dp. While 7/8 criteria pass, the missing criterion is mandatory (MDC3 touch target standard). Score: 65 (passes most requirements but fails critical accessibility/usability criterion).
